extracted.name: Homemade Hamburger Buns
extracted.description: Light and softer than regular. I found it online a long time ago.
instruction_lines: In the bowl a stand mixer with a dough hook, combine the warm water and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes.
Add the honey, melted butter, and egg. Mix until smooth.
Add in 2 cups flour and mix until blended.
Add salt and remaining flour, slowly and mix until you get a kneadable dough.
. Knead on low setting for 6 minutes.
Cover dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into 8 pieces and shape into buns. Place buns on a greased or parchment paper lined cookie sheet and light flatten the buns.
Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden brown.
